title: Insertion Sort
question: Sort numbers using insertion sort.
code:
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
for i in range(1, len(nums)):
    current = nums[i]
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and nums[j] > current:
        nums[j + 1] = nums[j]
        j -= 1
    nums[j + 1] = current
print(*nums)
explanation: Insertion sort inserts each item into its sorted left portion.
